parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bills (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, amount REAL, currency TEXT, due_day INTEGER, owner TEXT, category TEXT, status TEXT, last_paid TEXT, notes TEXT, remind_offsets TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '7,1,0');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT, bill_id INTEGER, message TEXT, channel TEXT, delivered INTEGER DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_at TEXT, workflow TEXT, status TEXT, detail TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  date TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount REAL NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  category TEXT,
  owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me',
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  receipt_path TEXT,
  external_id TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_expenses_external ON expenses(external_id) WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS savings_goals (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_amount REAL NOT NULL,
 current_amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 deadline TEXT,
 owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

WITH mock_goals (name, target_amount, current_amount, deadline, owner) AS (
  VALUES
    ('[DEMO] Emergency fund', 3000.00, 600.00, date('now', '+12 months'), 'shared'),
    ('[DEMO] Weekend getaway', 800.00, 200.00, date('now', '+6 months'), 'shared'),
    ('[DEMO] Home repairs', 1500.00, 300.00, date('now', '+9 months'), 'shared')
)
INSERT INTO savings_goals (name, target_amount, current_amount, deadline, owner, created_at)
SELECT mock.name, mock.target_amount, mock.current_amount, mock.deadline, mock.owner, datetime('now')
FROM mock_goals AS mock
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM savings_goals AS existing
  WHERE existing.name = mock.name AND existing.owner = mock.owner
);
